title: Litellm tokenizer test depends on live provider tokenizer behavior
reasoning: The test imports litellm directly and asserts exact behavior from litellm.encode for the external model id gpt-4o. That makes a backend unit test sensitive to installed litellm/tiktoken model mappings and tokenizer behavior rather than only verifying WindieOS projection logic. A dependency mapping change or missing tokenizer support can fail pytest even when canonicalize_tool_result_for_model still handles token limiting correctly.
recommendation: Mock or inject the tokenizer used by canonicalize_tool_result_for_model for this unit test, and keep one optional/integration-style test for real litellm coverage if needed.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current test is itself the brittle coverage; there is no local fake-tokenizer path here proving the projection contract independent of third-party tokenizer availability.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test that monkeypatches the projection module tokenizer call to return deterministic token counts and verifies truncation metadata without calling litellm.encode directly.
